metadata.title: PILOT GROUND-TRUTH RECOVERY TEST: JARDIM DAS NAÇÕES
rules_applied: Do not use QQQ/LLL sequential numbering to place parcels.
Do not assume odd/even parity alone confers EXACT_STREET_FACE.
Separate pre-existing knowledge from new recovery (incremental recovery only counted if stronger than pre-phase baseline).
Distinguish rediscovered baseline sources from newly discovered sources.

pilot_records.rediscovered_baseline_source: Diário Oficial Eletrônico de Taubaté - Edição 906 (URL: https://plenussistemas.dioenet.com.br/diario/publicacoes/33470)
pilot_records.supporting_evidence: Lote 13 and Quadra Q documented in Gazette 906. No door number or corner description present.
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Lote 13 and Quadra Q are confirmed from gazette 906. However, no door number or independent corner confrontation is present. Per the mandatory rule, lot contiguity cannot upgrade to Face-GT. Preserved as STREET_ONLY.

pilot_records.rediscovered_baseline_source: Diário Oficial Eletrônico de Taubaté - Edição 977 (URL: https://plenussistemas.dioenet.com.br/diario/publicacoes/35835)
pilot_records.new_source_found: Matrícula nº 86.760 CRI Taubaté (cited in Gazette 977 notice)
pilot_records.supporting_evidence: Door number 261, Lote 14, Quadra O, Matrícula 86.760 documented in Gazette 977.
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Gazette 977 establishes explicit binding to Rua França nº 261, Quadra O, Lote 14. However, the gazette notice lacks an independent corner description or boundary confrontation specifying the physical block side. Per the mandatory rule, parity (odd door number) cannot by itself upgrade a parcel to PROBABLE_STREET_FACE. Preserved strictly as STREET_ONLY.

pilot_records.supporting_evidence: Habite-se Residencial for Rua França nº 261.
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Habite-se binds BC to Rua França nº 261. Without independent spatial evidence defining the street side, parity alone is insufficient for a face upgrade. Preserved as STREET_ONLY.

pilot_records.rediscovered_baseline_source: Edital de Leilão Judicial - Franklin Leilões (URL: https://franklinleiloes.com.br/lote/imovel-jardim-das-nacoes-taubate-sp/821/)
pilot_records.new_source_found: Processo de Execução Cível nº 1004821-44.2021.8.26.0625 (1ª Vara Cível de Taubaté)
pilot_records.supporting_evidence: Lote 01 da Quadra A documented in Judicial Auction notice.
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Auction edital identifies Lote 01 da Quadra A on Rua França. Although lot 01 is typically a head lot, the notice text does not provide an explicit corner confrontation with the intersecting cross-street. Per the mandatory rule, head-lot contiguity alone cannot upgrade to PROBABLE_STREET_FACE. Preserved as STREET_ONLY.

pilot_records.supporting_evidence: Municipal tax notice binds BC to Rua Síria nº 560.
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Municipal notice documents Rua Síria nº 560. Without an independent public document placing this door number on a specific block face, parity cannot be used for upgrade. Preserved as STREET_ONLY.

pilot_records.supporting_evidence: Rua Síria nº 91, LT: 03, QD: X documented in Gazette 906.
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Gazette 906 binds BC to Rua Síria nº 91, LT: 03, QD: X. Without independent corner description or boundary confrontation, parity cannot upgrade it. Preserved as STREET_ONLY.
